source: Previous captured XIV setup, separated from the reset baseline
amendment: Action Bars: Replace native macros defaults off; other captured preferences retained. Player HP/MP default to current numbers; mob header icons use 2px spacing and the new right-hand anchor offsets. Other captured preferences retained. Target name uses a 6px HP-edge anchor with zero default X offset; other text settings retained. Target of Target explicitly uses theme defaults: below without arrow in XIV 1.0, inline with arrow in XI. Target of Target follows the main Target text profiles by default, retaining independent styles for opt-out. Player attack/recovery mini bars default to zero gap above TP/HP.
authored_amendment: Named preset explicitly selects XI Theme (appearance.theme=0); all captured settings otherwise retained.
compatibility_amendment: Make legacy direct-load semantics explicit when applying over newer settings: chat.native_windows_initialized=1 preserves the authored chat window count; minimap.zoom=4 and zoom_defaults_version=1 record the existing 3-to-4 default zoom migration.
